description: This file declares the 'Request' class used for JSON-RPC WebSocket communication, including methods for creating requests, retrieving IDs, and converting to string, along with internal ID generation logic.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC request message with methods to create requests, get IDs, and serialize to string, managing unique request IDs internally.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request to a string.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for each request, using an atomic counter.
